name: NCAA D-III Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Rock Island, IL · host Augustana · Saukie Golf Course
headline: Midwest Regional: North Central tops No. 1 Wartburg
summary: No. 3 North Central (Ill.) won the men’s title with 59 points over No. 1 Wartburg (82), with No. 12 Chicago third (90) and No. 13 Washington (Mo.) fourth (99), though Wartburg’s Isaiah Hammerand won the race in 23:53.7, 12.6 seconds clear of North Central’s Daniel Kasperan. No. 6 Chicago won the women’s title with 33 points, putting five in the top 12, ahead of No. 8 Washington (Mo.) (62) and No. 20 Wartburg (88). Washington’s Lucinda Laughlin won the women’s race in 21:04.6.
